'''Matthew Cody Carlson''' (born November 5, 1963) is an American former professional [[American football|football]] player who spent his entire eight year career as a [[quarterback]] for the [[Houston Oilers]] of the [[National Football League]] (NFL). His nickname while with the team was Commander Cody.<ref>[https://www.nytimes.com/1991/01/07/sports/sports-of-the-times-carlson-was-no-star-and-no-moon.html Berkow, Ira] "Carlson Was No Star, and No Moon", ''The New York Times'', January 7, 1991, page C3.</ref>
